v1_status: preserved negative result; never overwritten, reinterpreted, or used for v2 checkpoint selection
diagnostic_evidence: v1 had 7497 legal share states with zero masked-argmax share; forced legal share sent 128 B, unlocked remote process, and improved observable information age/covariance

reward_changes.communication_saving: 1 / (1 + actual_comm_delta_bytes / 128); smooth, monotone decreasing, fixed before training
reward_changes.delayed_estimate_quality: on an actual remote process only, add max(0, post_observable_quality_proxy - pre_observable_quality_proxy), capped at 1; proxy is equal age-quality and covariance-quality from arrived fusion tracks, with sigma scale 200 m
reward_changes.information_boundary: no truth_id, true error, future truth, offline labels, or unarrived messages

share_candidate_rule: raw outbox measurement permits a share candidate without first requiring a locally visible track; RuntimeExecutor remains the only sensor/communication/fusion side-effect entry and its accounting remains authoritative
network_and_ppo: same conditioned Actor-Critic [128,128], action space, mask, PPO parameters, updates, episodes and deterministic validation selection as v1
preference_sampling: per training episode: deterministic pseudorandom uniform draw from the frozen set using training_seed*100003+episode_index
mechanism_gate: for every training seed, legal-share masked argmax count must be nonzero; communication_saving must have no more share actions and no more bytes than estimate_quality; estimate_quality must have more share actions in validation handover than communication_saving. Otherwise retain the negative result and do not release test-v4.
test_v4_dependency: config/preference_ppo_v2_splits.json stays sealed; old test, test-v2 and test-v3 are historical only
